model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8, vLLM 0.27.1, greedy decoding; MinerU2.5-2509-1.2B parser
serving: serve/serve_qwen38_27b.sh; on the shared GPU GPU_UTIL 0.62-0.66, and from 14 October 2026 SPEC_TOKENS=2 (speculative decoding, which leaves greedy outputs unchanged up to floating-point batch effects)

results.configuration: final pipeline (v1.3), every form read again
final pipeline (v1.4), every document read again; the v1.3 fixes were found on this benchmark

changes_since_frozen.change: native files (.xlsx .docx .html .xml .csv .txt) become a text-layer PDF; small images are enlarged by a whole factor; chunked lists get the document's legends and per-subject tables; a failed planning call falls back instead of failing the document
the reference step also copies facts printed once (period, account, section), verbatim
a layout reader reads one list; the reader agent reads the schema's other fields
a timed-out model call is not re-sent

changes_since_frozen.results_touched: LongArray (applied to final outputs afterwards); no ExtractBench or VAREX output changes

changes_since_frozen.change: a layout reader that finds no records hands the document to the route
the quorum passes over a reading caught in a loop; the ruled reader only where rules are found
changes_since_frozen.results_touched: DocuBench (2 documents); checked to change nothing else

changes_since_frozen.change: a long scan keeps its page-image reading when the parse reading lost the list

final review: a task text no longer replaces the schema's own description; a short native file is read as text; native files keep Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Devanagari and Thai text (font fallback); transparent images are flattened onto white; a template may have fields named like schema keywords; nullable lists are found; a failed parse is not cached; a failing check leaves the reading as it was; the quorum no longer forks a threaded process (it could hang); a missing scorer package raises instead of making every agreement 0; layout readers only for schemas with a list; clear errors for unreadable or unsupported files
changes_since_frozen.results_touched: DocuBench (15 documents re-read with their descriptions: 86.44 -> 86.47); every other change was checked against the stored inputs and outputs of all benchmarks and changes none of them

changes_since_frozen.change: zoom re-reading: the zoomed reading counts as two votes, so it can overturn a lead of one reading but not a clear majority (found from the UNIKIE constrained test, where it first lowered the score 82.62 -> 81.62)
changes_since_frozen.results_touched: UNIKIE constrained headline 82.65 with zoom (development measurement); VAREX and UNIKIE open unchanged (the rule withdraws none of their changes)

changes_since_frozen.change: decoding admits null for optional scalar fields (no forced 0, 'null' text or copied values); decoding loops read again with a repetition penalty, then their repeats dropped; OCR text (a scan's parse, or an OCR text layer) sent with its page images in every call, at 300 dpi for chunks; long scans decided by the quorum; zoom compares numbers by value; zoom on by default (docs/DESIGN.md)
changes_since_frozen.results_touched: DocuBench 86.47 -> 90.80 (every document read again); VAREX 98.30 -> 98.23 (every form read again, 1st); LongArray-Extract and UNIKIE unaffected (their schemas and inputs meet none of the changed cases); ExtractBench is the stored run of an earlier version

changes_since_frozen.change: v1.4, for speed: every whole-document and chunk call asks the model server to end a reply once one stretch of 16-512 tokens has repeated 40 times in a row (vLLM repetition_detection), and a stopped reply takes the existing loop path; a scan's readings run at the same time and enter the quorum in the same order
changes_since_frozen.results_touched: DocuBench 90.80 -> 91.54 (every document read again; 26 changed, 16 up and 10 down) and its 20 sampled documents 2.4 times faster (12,564 s -> 5,225 s); VAREX 30 sampled forms 1.6 times faster, 29 identical to the stored run (the 30th differs by one field from the ruled-table reader, which neither change touches), so 98.23 stands; UNIKIE unaffected (its protocol's own calls); LongArray-Extract and ExtractBench are stored runs of earlier versions

rules: no answer key in any step of the method (answer keys only score finished outputs)
zero-shot with respect to each benchmark's output conventions
each benchmark scored with its own scorer; no leaderboard submission
